content:
maya: Quick heads-up — I onboarded q4_65b_ptq across regions (US-A100, EU-H100, APAC-H100) with kvstore in pagerized mode. Seeing a weird p99 tail for seqlen >= 2048 in APAC only. Numbers below.

igor: can you paste the exact command + config?

maya: run command:
```
redwood serve --model q4_65b_ptq --kv-mode=pagerized --prefetch=on --kernel=auto --quant=4bit
```

maya: tiny summary (steady-state tokens/s, p99 ms):
US-A100: 1400 t/s, p99 52 ms
EU-H100: 1620 t/s, p99 48 ms
APAC-H100: 1580 t/s, p99 121 ms (seqlen>=2048)
Hit rate collapse on APAC for long prefixes: hitrate ~0.42 vs 0.86 in US

lee: OOF. Is it kernel mismatch? auto picked triton-fused-prefetch on H100?

axel: can you dump kernel selection and nvprof? sometimes H100 chooses a slower fused kernel version that thrashes pager.

dev-qa: added a perf job to compare kernel=cuBLAS vs kernel=triton on APAC; will post logs when done.

sre-bot: perf-job/1771 finished. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perf/1771

igor: if hitrate drops, paging pressure will cause more host memcpy; check NVLINK saturation and host page-ins. Also check kv-eviction-lag (default 5s).

maya: short-term workaround: lowered kv-eviction-lag to 1s and enabled prefix-aggressive caching; p99 dropped to ~65 ms. Not ideal but buy time.

axel: interesting EU-H100 is fine. Maybe the APAC AMI had a different Triton/cuBLAS combo or kernel ABI. Check driver/cuda versions.

maya: confirmed APAC images are older (2025-11-02) vs EU/US (2025-11-10). Filing infra ticket to sync runtimes.

lee: for reproducibility — let's run a controlled seqlen sweep: 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096 and capture hitrate, host memcpy p50/p95/p99 across both kernels and across AMIs.

maya: putting checklist in perf doc: https://internal.redwood/notes/kv-warmup-quantize-171

dev-qa: kicked off sweep jobs with kernel=cuBLAS,triton and fixed load generators. Will attach CSVs and flamegraphs here.

maya: thanks — if anyone sees immediate red flags LMK. :slightly_smiling_face:

axel: one more note: check quantization layout/bias-correction patch; a misaligned kv key encoding can increase key size and cause bucket churn (lower hitrate).

maya: good call — adding layout/bias-check to the run. Will update later today.
